name: From Code Generation to Control: Engineering Reliable Software with AI
outcome: Carry out a traceable software change with human-controlled decisions.
description: Use a controlled software development lifecycle to introduce a research software change. Trace requirements, design decisions, implementation, verification and validation through explicit human review and approval points.
external: Software engineering fundamentals: requirements, architecture, Git, testing and code review.
learn: Trace requirements through a gated development lifecycle
Use isolated, reviewable changes and retain evidence
Validate acceptance criteria and hand off an auditable change
tools: Your chosen CLI (Claude Code or Codex)
moduleDescriptions: Define acceptance criteria, trace requirements and review a bounded change plan.
Use the existing SSC lifecycle workflow with explicit human approval before edits.
Use an isolated branch and retain a trace of decisions and verification artifacts.
Run independent gates and acceptance checks, then review the handoff.
practice: Apply the existing SSC controlled-lifecycle exercise to a conflicting change request.
acceptance: Requirements, design, approval, implementation and acceptance evidence are traceable; all gates are independently checked.
prerequisiteRationale: S04 supplies verification and audit evidence used at the human approval gates.
